statement: Let A be an abelian category with exact countable products and enough injectives, and let D(A) and Q be its derived category and localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with any chosen countable products in D(A). Let I be a K-injective cochain complex of inverse systems indexed by the opposite of the natural numbers (every map to I from an acyclic complex of inverse systems is null-homotopic). Let c be a limit cone of the evaluation functor I.asFunctor from the opposite of the natural numbers to complexes of A. Put K_n = Q(I.asFunctor(n)) and f_n = Q(I.asFunctor(n+1 → n)), and let p : Q(c.pt) → ∏ K_n be the product lift of the localized cone projections. There exists δ : ∏ K_n → Q(c.pt)[1] for which Q(c.pt) → ∏ K_n → ∏ K_n → Q(c.pt)[1], with arrows p, 1-shift [def-weil-tower-transition-endomorphism] and δ, is a distinguished triangle [def-weil-derived-limit]. This statement involves only the tower evaluated from I, not an arbitrary isomorphic tower.

proof.text: Evaluation at each level preserves K-injectivity. Construct the termwise product fan and apply the K-injective product theorem to obtain a limiting fan after localization.

Use the universal property of the product complex to construct iota from the supplied limit cone and t as identity minus the transition shift. Their projection equations follow from the universal property.
The Roos construction gives a distinguished triangle with first map Q(iota), second map Q(t), and both middle objects Q(P.pt).

Use the unique isomorphism from the localized product fan to the chosen derived-category product. Checking projections identifies the transported first map with p and the second with the transition endomorphism. Transport distinguishedness along the resulting triangle isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem derivedCategory_towerLimit_triangle
    (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCountableProducts A] [CountableAB4Star A]
    (hP : HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory A)) :
    letI : HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory A) := hP
    ∀ (_ : EnoughInjectives A)
      (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective]
      (c : Cone I.asFunctor), IsLimit c →
      let K₀ := fun n : ℕ ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (I.asFunctor.obj (Opposite.op n))
      let f₀ := fun n : ℕ ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.map
        (I.asFunctor.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op)
      let p := Pi.lift (fun n : ℕ ↦ DerivedCategory.Q.map (c.π.app (Opposite.op n)))
      ∃ δ : (∏ᶜ K₀) ⟶ (DerivedCategory.Q.obj c.pt)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
        IsDerivedLimitTriangle f₀ (DerivedCategory.Q.obj c.pt) p δ

title: Canonical Roos triangle of the localized evaluation tower
